suggested_snapshot_fields_to_add.why: Provides the exact [q,r] that must be copied into actions[].target_cell for this option, removing end_cell vs allowed_end_cells ambiguity.
Union of all cells actually hit, threatened, or intercepted by the option, so exact required-cell and predicted-landing checks use one deterministic field.
Directly supports retreat/survival intents by exposing whether the option's end state avoids visible enemy attack range.
